case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

response.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your response and the data provided; we have reviewed the recent developments in AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 and can reflect these in our pricing. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We are agreeable to your proposed 36-month contract term and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause to manage future fluctuations. With these terms in place, we can offer a revised price of €5.50 per unit. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always appreciate working with your team and supporting your operations with our extensive inventory and dedicated service.

Following our recent discussions, we are pleased to outline our terms: a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We have made significant concessions to reach this level, and we must therefore present this as our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We hope these terms work well for your upcoming planning and look forward to your response.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
